text:
sara: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a compact remediation plan for streaming/chat timeouts and partial replies. Goal: ship a 2-week sprint of measurable mitigations and owners.

alex: +1. propose we split into: 1) client/backoff tests, 2) server-side handshake & heartbeat, 3) observability/alerts for partial chunks.

jamal: I can take client/backoff. my first task is an automated e2e that reproduces partial-response patterns under shallow networks.

maria: I'll own heartbeat/handshake. current hypothesis: if handshake RTT > 800ms some KV cache eviction path triggers early stream close. need a repro harness.

kevin: observability plan: add a metric 'stream.partial_chunks' and a histogram for 'handshake_latency_ms'. also alert when partials > 0.5% p95 over 10m.

elliot: ops-bot ran the deploy during the incident and surfaced 2 noisy nodes — see log snippet.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] 2299998850: rolling-restart shard-gpu-7 -> completed.

alex: Action items I put on the board (short):
- A1 Alex: client retry matrix + e2e tests (owners: alex, jamal) // due 2026-03-30
- A2 Maria: handshake hardening + repro harness // due 2026-03-29
- A3 Kevin: metrics + alert rules + dashboards // due 2026-03-28
- A4 Elliot: node health sweep + eviction tuning PR // due 2026-03-27

jamal: For A1 I'll add the following test matrix to CI: bandwidth throttling, SYN latency injection, and socket flapping. quick pseudo config:
```
# e2e client backoff matrix
scenarios:
  - name: slow-rtt
    rtt_ms: [100, 300, 800, 1200]
  - name: packet-loss
    loss_pct: [0, 1, 3]
```

maria: For handshake we should add an explicit heartbeat ack every 5s during handshake-window. If no ack in 3 tries, keep stream alive but mark 'degraded' and return partial indicator to clients. This lets clients decide to reconnect vs wait.

kevin: On alerts: propose two gates: (1) partial-response-rate > 0.5% in 10m -> pager to oncall, (2) handshake-rtt p95 > 1s for 30m -> ticket to eng-runtime. Also add a short-runbook for triage.

elliot: I'll schedule a maintenance test window tomorrow 03:00 UTC to repro the noisy-node eviction with load. ETA 30m.

alex: Example quick fix for client SDK to reduce UX impact — exponential backoff + jitter + resume token usage instead of full stream retry. snippet for reconnect policy:
```
reconnect:
  max_attempts: 6
  base_ms: 250
  jitter_pct: 0.3
  resume_token_ok: true
```

jamal: Good. Also we should add a server-side short-circuit that prevents closing streams if resume_token_ok is present. saves some partials.

maria: I'm going to prototype handshake ack and a 'partial_reason' tag on stream frames so we can correlate client vs server-side causes.

sara: Timeline check — weekly checkin in 7 days. please update the action items in the postmortem doc when you start work and mark progress as: blocked/in-progress/done. I'll run the follow-up review.

kevin: I'll add dashboard tiles and annotate last incident window for before/after comparison.

elliot: maintenance window created: 2026-03-24T03:00:00Z. tagging @oncall for awareness.

alex: Quick question: do we want auto-fallback to a lower-latency model variant on handshake failure? that could reduce client-perceived timeouts.

maria: Possibly, but need to ensure quality/semantic degradation acceptable. add as stretch (A5) — we can measure with a small sample cohort.

jamal: I'll start the e2e harness tomorrow and push a branch. tagging the PR with 'incident-followup'.

ops-bot: [incident-tracker] linked actions: A1,A2,A3,A4 -> incident 2299998801.

sara: Great. Owners please drop short notes when you make progress. If any blocker, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
